scope: E05 native TimeSeries query execution: optimize ContextTimeSeriesTagsCollector::removeAllTagsExcept(vector, one-label) by interning distinct retained tag values, avoiding per-input-series projected tag object/hash registration. Batch source group lookups under short shared locks; use bounded UInt16 indices, unique-value cap and conservative fallback. Reuse pinned R35 metric-name deferral as the candidate baseline; do not alter storage, selector, native range aggregation, R34, R30/R31 or metadata JOINs.
hypothesis: For N input groups and D distinct values of one retained label (D much smaller than N), project and intern each output label set once, then map N input rows through bounded indices; expected new tag objects O(D), instead of O(N) for all-unique source groups.
guards: distinct retained tag values <= min(4096, N/8)
fallback before collector mutation on overflow
no repeated label construction on cache hit
original method for all other cases
candidate: R35 plus one collector-function change, same pinned source and toolchain
falsifier: native output mismatch, different error handling, compilation failure, no stable speed/CPU gain or memory/RSS regression on 1.33m/14d and dense high-cardinality controls
runner_budget: one source-matched candidate build and one ABBA benchmark, no competing compile lane
